Water purifiers are trending up. Search interest is climbing per Google Trends data, and there's no single obvious trigger behind it. That absence of a story is its own kind of signal.

Not every mover has a festival tied to it. Sometimes it's just steady demand building, easy to miss if you're not checking daily.
